sentences.ko: 거기를 확인해 볼 생각을 왜 못 했을까.
sentences.text: I don't know why we didn't think to check there.

alts.text: Weird that we never thought to check there.
It is strange that we did not think to check there.

sentences.note: **didn't think to check** 는 '확인할 줄 몰랐다'가 아니라 '확인할 생각 자체를 못 했다'는 뜻입니다. 찾던 물건이 엉뚱한 데서 나왔을 때처럼, 뻔한 곳을 놓쳤을 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.text: Okay, I better just say what it is I'm going to say.

alts.text: Fine, let me just come out with it.
Very well, I should simply say what I came to say.

sentences.note: **I better just** 는 망설이다가 마음먹고 말을 꺼낼 때 앞에 붙이는 말입니다. 'I had better' 의 구어 축약이라 친구 사이에서 자연스럽습니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 너 빠지면 편이 안 맞아서 다들 너한테 뭐라고 할걸.
sentences.text: And if you don't play, everyone will be mad at you cuz the teams won't be even.

alts.text: You sit out and the teams are uneven, so everyone's gonna be annoyed.
If you do not participate, the teams will be uneven and everyone will be upset with you.

sentences.note: **the teams won't be even** 은 편을 갈랐을 때 인원이 안 맞는다는 뜻입니다. 운동이나 게임에서 한 명이 빠지려 할 때 붙잡는 말로 씁니다. 화난 대상은 **mad at you** 처럼 at 으로 가리킵니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 친구라서 하는 말 아니야, 진짜로 그래.
sentences.text: And I'm not just saying this cuz I'm your friend.

alts.text: Honestly, I'd say the same even if we weren't friends.
This is my honest opinion, not merely what a friend would say.

sentences.note: **I'm not just saying this** 는 칭찬이나 평가를 한 뒤에 '빈말 아니다'라고 못 박는 말입니다. 보통 뒤에 이유(cuz I'm your friend)를 붙여 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 8 | Friends

sentences.ko: 침대에서 방방 뛰다가 그랬다고 의사한테 말했어?
sentences.text: Did you tell the doctor you did it jumping up and down on your bed?

alts.text: So did the doctor hear the part about the bed?
Did you inform the doctor that it happened while you were jumping on your bed?

sentences.note: **you did it jumping up and down on your bed** 처럼 'did it + -ing' 로 다친 경위를 말합니다. '~하다가 그랬다'에 해당하고, 다쳤을 때 어쩌다 그랬냐고 묻고 답하는 자리에서 그대로 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 결혼 생활 유지하는 게 얼마나 힘든 건지 넌 모를 거야.
sentences.text: You have no idea what it takes to make a marriage work.

alts.text: Trust me, keeping a marriage going is way harder than it looks.
Sustaining a marriage demands far more than you realize.

sentences.note: **what it takes to**는 '그 일을 해내는 데 드는 것'이라는 뜻으로, 겪어 보지 않은 사람에게 '몰라서 하는 소리야' 할 때 씁니다. 관계를 굴러가게 한다는 뜻으로 **make a marriage work**처럼 work를 쓰는 것도 같이 익혀 두세요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.text: Let's just leave it there for a while.

alts.text: Can we drop it for now?
Perhaps we should set this aside for the time being.

sentences.note: **leave it there**는 하던 얘기를 더 밀어붙이지 않고 그 자리에서 멈추자는 말입니다. 말이 커지기 전에 끊을 때, 회의를 마무리할 때 그대로 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 1 | Friends

sentences.ko: 여기 오는 길에 사람들이 꽤 쳐다보더라.
sentences.text: I turned quite a few heads on my way over here.

alts.text: Got a lot of looks walking over here.
A fair number of people looked my way as I came here.

sentences.note: **turned quite a few heads**는 눈에 띄어서 사람들이 고개를 돌려 봤다는 뜻입니다. 차림이 근사할 때 남 얘기로도, 이렇게 자기 얘기로도 씁니다. **quite a few**는 '적다'가 아니라 '꽤 많다'입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 꼭 하나를 포기해야 한다면 뭘 포기할래?
sentences.text: If you had to, what would you give up?

alts.text: Say you had no choice. What are you giving up?
Supposing you had no choice, what would you be willing to give up?

sentences.note: **If you had to**는 뒤에 동사를 붙이지 않고 그대로 끊어 씁니다. 앞에 나온 말을 받아 '꼭 그래야 한다면'이라는 뜻이 되고, 가정해서 묻는 질문을 던질 때 통째로 붙입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 그건 말로 설명하기 진짜 어려웠을 거야.
sentences.text: That would have been really hard to describe.

alts.text: You'd have had a real hard time explaining that one.
It would have been quite difficult to put into words.

sentences.note: **would have been**은 실제로 일어나지 않은 일을 두고 '그랬으면 ~했을 텐데' 하고 말할 때 씁니다. 안 해서 다행일 때도, 아쉬울 때도 같은 모양입니다. **hard to describe**는 '뭐라 말해야 할지 모르겠는' 느낌이에요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends
